latest_release.name: RealSense SDK 2.0 beta (v2.59.2)
latest_release.body:
![Download Counter](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/realsenseai/librealsense/v2.59.2/total.svg)

## What's new

### Highlights

- **D400 HDR** — Emitter Enabled and Laser Power can be changed while HDR is active over USB too, matching GMSL.
- **Improved Close Range Depth** — clear error on unsupported Depth profiles or a mode change while streaming; `embedded_close_range_filter` available from Python.
- **D500 tare calibration** — runs with the Custom visual preset and restores the user's settings when done.
- **macOS IMU** — IMU streaming on D400 / D500 USB cameras; D436 gyro sensitivity fixed.
- **Performance** — AVX2 YUY2 to RGB/BGR unpacking; Viewer rendering no longer blocks IMU capture.
- **Jetson** — JetPack 6.2.3 (L4T 36.5.2) support.
- **Web-based viewer** — theme rework, IMU history graphs, real SDK stream profiles; REST API `--host` / `--port`.

### Bug Fixes

- Fix HDR merge never using IR: depth and IR matched by sensor timestamp.
- Fix temporal filter showing corrupted depth frames after a rotation change or stream restart.
- Fix cached depth scale after advanced-mode table writes.
- Fix advanced-mode JSON float parsing under comma-decimal locales.
- Fix slow sensor close; keep frame callbacks alive while they are invoked.
- Fix pyrealsense2 crash on import in Linux shared builds.
- Linux V4L2: stop video before metadata on UVC devices; fix video / metadata pairing with interleaved nodes; fix fd leak and metadata size wrap.
- MIPI: retry EBUSY on control get / set like USB; FW error polling on D400 GMSL; FW update targets the right camera on multi-camera setups.
- DDS: compressed (MJPEG / H.264) frames no longer dropped; D555 IMU axes aligned with USB.
- Jetson JP5: fix USB wedge after a color stream stop (D436 stopped answering control commands until power cycle).

Various bugs fixes - see full release notes in [Release Notes](https://github.com/realsenseai/librealsense/wiki/Release-Notes).

### Supported Platforms

* **Ubuntu 26.04/24.04/22.04/20.04 LTS** <sup>(1)</sup>. Kernel versions: 6.[2, 5, 8, 11, 14], 5.[0, 3, 4, 8, 13, 15, 19].
* **Windows 11**<sup>(3)</sup> and **Windows 10** (Build 15063 or later, 17763+ recommended).
* **NVIDIA® Jetson™** Jetpack 5(.0.2), 6.[0,1,2], 7(.0)
* **Mac OS** (High Sierra 10.13.2 & 12+)<sup>(4)</sup>
* **Android**<sup>(4)</sup> 14, 13, 12, 11, 10<sup>(5)</sup>, 9, 8, 7. <sup>(6)</sup>

<sup>(1)</sup> Please refer to the [Release Notes](https://github.com/realsenseai/librealsense/wiki/Release-Notes#release-2572-beta) for known issues
<sup>(2)</sup> Non-LTS Ubuntu kernels with manual patches, check build from source instructions
<sup>(3)</sup> There is 50% probability of up to 80% frame drops with Windows 11 builds 22621.3296 and 22631.3296 (KB5035853). Windows 10 RS5 or Win 11 KB5030219 (OS Build 22621.2283) do not have any frame drops
<sup>(4)</sup> This is compilable, but not validated
<sup>(5)</sup> Due to a [known issue with Android 10](https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/145082934) the Depth cameras may not be recognized by some ROM/Platform vendors.
<sup>(6)</sup> IMU stream is not working well on latest versions
